definitions.explanation: A reputation that is widely recognized and settled, almost always a good one.

examples.english: It has an established reputation for its taste.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{接客|せっきゃく}→接客：12882_sekkyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{定評|ていひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This shop is well known for its good service.
